preexisting_worker_patch:
diff --git a/tools/rfq-worker-v2/worker.mjs b/tools/rfq-worker-v2/worker.mjs
index cefbcb9..69f9b2c 100644
--- a/tools/rfq-worker-v2/worker.mjs
+++ b/tools/rfq-worker-v2/worker.mjs
@@ -145,7 +145,7 @@ async function notifySales(env, lead) {
   const email = renderRfqEmail(lead);
 
   await sendWithResend(env, {
-    from: env.FROM_EMAIL || 'RubberQ RFQ <onboarding@resend.dev>',
+    from: env.FROM_EMAIL || 'RubberQ RFQ <contact@rubberq.com>',
     to: env.TO_EMAIL || 'contact@rubberq.com',
     reply_to: lead.email,
     subject: email.subject,
diff --git a/tools/rfq-worker-v2/wrangler.toml b/tools/rfq-worker-v2/wrangler.toml
index 4ed0ca8..70de950 100644
--- a/tools/rfq-worker-v2/wrangler.toml
+++ b/tools/rfq-worker-v2/wrangler.toml
@@ -2,6 +2,10 @@ name = "rubberq-rfq-api"
 main = "worker.mjs"
 compatibility_date = "2025-10-08"
 
+routes = [
+  { pattern = "rubberq.com/api/*", zone_name = "rubberq.com" }
+]
+
 [[d1_databases]]
 binding = "DB"
 database_name = "rubberq_rfq"
@@ -9,5 +13,5 @@ database_id = "e51f8f7e-6137-45f4-acb4-61dc4eb3def7"
 
 [vars]
 ALLOWED_ORIGIN = "https://rubberq.com,https://www.rubberq.com,https://rubberq-site.pages.dev,https://rubberq-astro.pages.dev"
-FROM_EMAIL = "RubberQ RFQ <onboarding@resend.dev>"
+FROM_EMAIL = "RubberQ RFQ <contact@rubberq.com>"
 TO_EMAIL = "contact@rubberq.com"
scope: Preserve and adopt the existing correct sender-domain and production-route changes as required RFQ release prerequisites. Other preexisting changes remain excluded.
